comments: Based on axe-core 4.10.2, extended with own keyboard/focus/contrast/reflow probes.
features: Complianty checks websites against WCAG 2.1 AA / EN 301 549 for the German Accessibility Act (BFSG). It combines automated axe-core tests with a guided review of 12 manual checkpoints, pre-filled by keyboard, focus, contrast and reflow measurements, with screenshot evidence, PDF reports and a generated accessibility statement.
title: Complianty Accessibility Check
